root_cause.explanation: Coverage ended 2026-05-31 per 271 DTP*357; DOS 2026-06-07 is six days post-termination. Payer issued CO-27 on all five therapy lines.

evidence.fact: EB*6 (inactive coverage) with DTP*357*D8*20260531 — coverage terminated May 31 2026, before DOS June 7 2026.
